title: Cashew Fajita with Herbal Salsa
description: A Mexican-inspired dish featuring sautéed cashews, tender vegetables, and a fresh herbal salsa. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cumin, chili powder, and dried oregano. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the onion and bell pepper. Cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the cashews and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve with a fresh herbal salsa made by combining the herbs, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
Optional: Serve with warm flour or corn tortillas.
